Data Scientist – Credit Risk Modelling

Experience: 7+ Years

Location: Mumbai – Work from Office 

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist – Credit Risk Modelling with strong expertise in predictive analytics, statistical modelling, and credit risk analytics. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing and implementing credit risk models and scorecards within the Banking or Financial Services domain. 

The role will involve working closely with risk, business, and technology teams to develop data-driven analytical solutions, enhance model performance, and support model validation, governance, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, implement, and enhance Credit Risk Models for retail and corporate lending portfolios.
- Design, build, validate, and monitor predictive models for credit risk assessment.
- Develop and maintain Application, Behavioral, and Collection Scorecards.
- Perform statistical analysis to identify key risk drivers and improve model accuracy and performance.
- Analyze large and complex datasets to derive actionable business and risk insights.
- Conduct model validation, monitoring, recalibration, and performance assessment.
- Ensure risk models align with applicable regulatory, governance, and compliance requirements.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders, risk teams, and technology teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
- Prepare comprehensive model documentation, analytical reports, presentations, and regulatory submissions.
- Support model governance, independent validation, audit, and regulatory review activities.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of risk analytics methodologies, modelling frameworks, and processes.

Mandatory Skills & Experience 

Core Experience

- 7+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Credit Risk Analyst, Risk Modelling Analyst, or similar role.
- Strong hands-on experience in Credit Risk Modelling.
- Proven experience in Predictive Modelling and statistical analysis.
- Hands-on experience in Scorecard Development.
- Strong understanding of statistical modelling techniques and risk analytics.
- Relevant experience within the Banking, NBFC, or Financial Services domain.

Technical Skills 
- Credit Risk Modelling
- Predictive Modelling
- Statistical Modelling
- Application, Behavioral & Collection Scorecards
- Data Analysis & Data Mining
- Python / R / SAS
- SQL
- Machine Learning Algorithms
- Advanced Excel
- Data Visualization using Power BI / Tableau – Preferred

Preferred Skills 
- Working knowledge of Basel regulations and IFRS 9 modelling.
- Understanding of Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), and Exposure at Default (EAD) models.
- Experience developing risk models using SAS, Python, or R.
- Experience in Model Validation, Model Monitoring, and Model Governance.
- Strong understanding of risk analytics, regulatory reporting, and model lifecycle management.
- Experience working with large-scale financial and credit datasets.

Soft Skills 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced workplace.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.
- Ability to effectively communicate complex analytical and modelling concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Educational Qualification Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or another relevant quantitative discipline.

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of solutions that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.



Job Description

About the role:



As a Lead Data Scientist with a focus on GenAI (Generative Artificial Intelligence), you will be at the forefront of pioneering innovative applications of data science and machine learning in employee engagement. In this role, you will lead efforts to leverage GenAI techniques to address unique challenges within our company, including building a state of the art conversational servicebot that should scale across a million MAU, developing cutting edge production AI/ML solutions to complex Text2Action problems, time series data to look for anomalous behavior. Imagine the next generation of IT services being offered not via dashboards or clicks or filters but in an interactive, conversational manner, backed by real time analysis of the entire streaming data into an operating center. This vision is what you would make into a reality. You will build algorithms that analyze these millions of streaming data points, build a distributed, scalable, and high-performance system to serve the insights to the customer through a next-gen conversational UI/UX.  

Responsibilities:



Strategic Collaboration: Collaborate closely with product and business teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of the challenges and opportunities within the GenAI landscape, aligning data science initiatives with the organization's objectives.Metric Definition: Define key performance metrics that accurately reflect the value delivered to end-users through GenAI solutions.Intelligent System Design: Apply deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, and advanced mathematics to conceptualize, experiment, and design intelligent systems powered by GenAI.Big Data Processing: Develop efficient systems capable of processing vast volumes of data, demonstrating proficiency in distributed programming frameworks like Hadoop and Spark.ML/AI Architecture: Collaborate closely with ML Engineers to design scalable systems and model architectures that enable real-time ML/AI services.End-to-End ML Pipelines: Take ownership of ML pipelines from end to end, encompassing data pre-processing, model generation, cross-validation, and feedback sharing.

Qualifications

Qualifications:



A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, with a minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience.Strong problem-solving and programming skills, coupled with a profound understanding of the mathematical foundations underpinning machine learning algorithms, including probability, statistics, linear algebra, calculus, and optimization.Proven track record of successfully deploying ML projects in production systems with substantial individual contributions.Experience with natural language processing tasks utilizing prompt engineering, LLMs, transformers, and knowledge graphs is highly advantageous. Proficiency in time series analysis, NLP, Distributed Systems, large-scale computing, and Big Data technologies such as and Spark is a plus.A solid background in at least 2 of the following areas: Natural language processing, statistical ML techniques, graph algorithms, constraint optimization, signal processing (speech or vision), deep learning, and distributed systems.Proficiency with database systems and schema design, encompassing both SQL and NoSQL databases.

Additional Information

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

Job Title: Data Scientist Consultant 

 

Overview:
SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider dedicated to helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in enhancing supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will possess experience in demand planning, forecasting models, machine learning, and data analysis, along with the ability to work closely with customers to improve forecast accuracy and optimize planning performance. This position requires strong analytical thinking, hands-on technical capability, and the ability to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and recommend continuous improvements to forecasting processes.

jobs_results.description:
Requirements: 

Experience: 1-3 years in Machine Learning, NLP, or Generative AI roles.Programming: Strong proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch/TensorFlow, etc. ).NLP Knowledge: Good understanding of: Text preprocessing, Tokenization and embeddings, Language modeling, Sequence-to-sequence tasks, and Evaluation metrics.Transformer Architectures: Familiarity with models such as BERT, GPT, T5 and Llama.Model Development Experience: Fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs/NLP models, Training and evaluating ML models, Data preparation and experimentation, Hyperparameter tuning, Model deployment experience is a plus.Core Fundamentals: Data structures and algorithms, Statistics and probability, Linear algebra and optimization, and Machine learning concepts (supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning).If this is for a Generative AI role, a strong candidate would have hands-on experience with: Fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA/QLoRA, Working with frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers, Building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, Prompt engineering and evaluation, Vector databases, and PyTorch-based model training and inference.


Preferred Educational Background: 

Candidates from premier Indian institutes such as Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs), Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Indian Institutes of Information Technology (IIITs), Birla Institute of Technology and Science, and Top National Institutes of Technology (NITs).
